# Generated by mods/cm_dev_perf/tools/port_from_cm_dev.py; not to be edited by hand.
# Auto-Build production's hiring horizon (+perf44). Root is the location.
cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months = {
	value = 72
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { exists = var:cm_ab_production_horizon } }
		value = owner.var:cm_ab_production_horizon
		multiply = 12
	}
}

# Free places of scope:cm_building_type's pop type, plus the horizon's fill, less one level's jobs.
# Non-negative: a new level is staffed within the horizon.
cm_perf_ab_prod_slack = {
	value = cm_location_unemployed_for_building_type
	if = {
		limit = { "global_variable_map(cm_building_type_to_pop_type|scope:cm_building_type)" = pop_type:nobles }
		value = cm_location_nobles_available
		add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_nobles multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { "global_variable_map(cm_building_type_to_pop_type|scope:cm_building_type)" = pop_type:clergy }
		value = cm_location_clergy_available
		add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_clergy multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { "global_variable_map(cm_building_type_to_pop_type|scope:cm_building_type)" = pop_type:burghers }
		value = cm_location_burghers_available
		add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_burghers multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { "global_variable_map(cm_building_type_to_pop_type|scope:cm_building_type)" = pop_type:laborers }
		value = cm_location_laborers_available
		add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_laborers multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { "global_variable_map(cm_building_type_to_pop_type|scope:cm_building_type)" = pop_type:soldiers }
		value = cm_location_soldiers_available
		add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_soldiers multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { "global_variable_map(cm_building_type_to_pop_type|scope:cm_building_type)" = pop_type:peasants }
		value = cm_location_peasants_available
		add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_peasants multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
	}
	subtract = scope:cm_building_type.employment_size
}

# cm_location_rgo_promotion_buffer_slack with the slider's years.
cm_perf_ab_prod_rgo_slack = {
	value = cm_location_laborers_or_slaves_available
	add = { value = cm_location_fill_rate_for_laborers_or_slaves multiply = cm_perf_ab_prod_horizon_months }
